record_title: An active-separated-quiver refinement of the 3s+1 self-extension bound
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The bound is algebra-sensitive rather than a uniform improvement: it coincides with 3s+1 when the active separated-quiver counts and second-layer matching number are all maximal. Existing special-case results can be sharper. The full text of Hoshino (1989) was not inspected, leaving residual coverage risk. No independent validation is asserted.
